## Relias Social Media Policy

## Policy Statement

Relias makes extensive use of social media to communicate with our customers and business partners as part of marketing activities. Social media efforts provide support for our products and services and enhances the collection of data on how our organization is perceived. Social Media use also promotes our culture, employment and the Relias brand to potential applicants, current employees, and potential and current customers. Employees' use of Social Media can pose risks to Relias' Confidential Information, reputation, and can jeopardize compliance with contractual and legal obligations if not used responsibly and in accordance with this policy.

This policy provides guidelines for making responsible decisions about employee use of social media either as part of job requirements or as a private person as it relates to Relias and the Relias brand.

## Definitions

| Term                     | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|--------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Social Media             | Social media includes: (I) all means of communicating or posting information or content of any sort on the Internet, including to your own or someone else's web log or blog, journal, personal web site, social networking or affinity web site, web bulletin board or a chat room, whether or not associated or affiliated with Relias, as well as any other form of electronic communication, including but not limited to: Social Networking Sites (Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Twitter, TikTok 1 , Pinterest) Blogging platforms (Tumblr; including company and personal blogs) • Online Encyclopedias (Wikipedia) • Video and photo-sharing websites (YouTube, Flickr) • Other social media platforms and any other form of electronic communication that may apply                                 |
| Confidential Information | Proprietary, internal, or valuable business information that is not available to the public. It includes trade secrets and other intellectual property that has been developed, licensed, or acquired by Relias. It can also include information of clients, customers, business partners, or others that has been disclosed to Relias under obligations of confidentiality. Examples include unannounced financial information, strategic business plans, organization structures, mergers and acquisitions, unannounced product or services and solutions offerings, planned or contemplated mergers or acquisitions, lawsuits and other legal proceedings, product design and technical knowledge, customer and team member personally identifiable information. This is not an all-inclusive list. No Confidential |

Information  should  be  posted  on  Social  Media  or  otherwise  disclosed  without  first obtaining the appropriate written permissions from authorized parties.

## Policy Applicability

This policy covers all employees as well as individuals providing services on Relias' behalf (e.g., officers, consultants, interns, contract workers, and agency workers). Third parties who have access to our electronic communication systems and equipment are also required to comply with this policy.

Carefully read this policy and the applicable Additional Policies and Documentation that Apply to Social Media Use as referenced below to ensure that Social Media related activities are consistent with this policy and all other applicable Relias policies.

## Policy Details

The following requirements must be adhered to when using Social Media on behalf of Relias or if the Relias and Relias' family of brands is mentioned.

1. Authorization to post: Do not speak on behalf of Relias, unless given explicit permission . You must be authorized by the Social Team and Brand Team to use Social Media and to represent Relias as part of your job role. Please note that Instagram account use must be authorized by the People Team.
2. Official Relias Social Media accounts: Only authorized accounts should be used to publish messages and respond to other users of Social Media channels on behalf of Relias. Do not use your own personal account for Relias business or marketing-related posts on behalf of Relias.
3. Company affiliation: Identify yourself as a Relias employee on Social Media sites, when posting or engaging with other users, and while discussing Relias business and related industry topics/events. If you talk about work-related matters that are within your area of job responsibility, you must disclose your affiliation with Relias. This can be done by stating you work at Relias within the social copy of the post, tagging @Relias, or adding a hashtag to the end of your post #LifeatRelias.
4. Confidential information: Do not publish, post, or release Confidential Information. Please remember that you are still subject to the Confidentiality, Invention, Assignment, Non-solicit, Non-compete, and Arbitration Agreement (CINNAA) you signed when you joined Relias.

## 5. Company reputation

- a. Avoid any statements that might harm Relias 's reputation and brand equity including comments in response to any posts published by Relias or any of our brands.
- b. You represent Relias and the Relias brand. As an employee, your actions both on and offline can affect perceptions of Relias. Only official spokespersons are permitted to speak directly for Relias and only in specific, approved instances.
- c. If you see something problematic on our social channels, share your concerns directly with the Social Team or Brand Team. This protects the credibility, trust, and authority of our brands while increasing collaboration and transparency.

## 6. Legal liability

![Image](data:image/png;base64,)

- a. Avoid commenting on any matters that might be subject to or may result in legal action either by or against the organization. Contact the Legal Team for guidance on the appropriate way to respond.
- b. Employees can be legally liable for what is posted online. Relias reserves the right to discipline employees, up to and including summary dismissal or termination, for any commentary, content or images that are pornographic, harassing, and libelous or for anything that creates a hostile work environment based on race, sex, religion, or any other status protected by law or company policy, or for anything that depicts Relias and/or the Relias brand in a negative light as shall be determined in Relias' sole discretion.

## 7. Respectability

- a. Avoid using words or styles (such as all capital letters) or posting materials or comments that may be offensive, demeaning, inappropriate, threatening, personally insulting, or abusive to others. Treat past and present employees, customers, business partners, competitors, Relias, and yourself with respect. Acknowledge differences of opinions. Respectfully withdraw from discussions that go off topic or become profane.
- b. Keep in mind that you are more likely to resolve work-related complaints by speaking directly with your co-workers than by posting complaints on Social Media. If you decide to post complaints or criticism, avoid using statements, photographs, video, or audio that could be reasonably viewed as malicious, obscene, threatening or intimidating, that disparages coworkers, or that might constitute harassment or bullying. Nothing in this policy is meant to curtail an employee's protected, concerted activity in addressing work related issues via Social Media.
- c. Consider the global nature of Social Media and be mindful of the fact that a statement may be interpreted in different ways in different countries or cultures, even if you are only marketing to a certain country or a select group of individuals.

## 8. Honesty

- a. Use your real identity and credentials to ensure credibility.
- b. Always be honest and accurate when posting information or news, and if you make a mistake, correct it quickly to build trust and add value when engaging with your audience.
- c. Be open about any previous posts you have altered. Remember that the Internet archives almost everything. Therefore, even deleted postings can be searched.
- d. Never post any information that you know to be false about Relias, fellow employees, customers, business partners, others working on behalf of Relias or competitors.
- e. Before posting on Social Media, consider how it will reflect upon you, your colleagues, and Relias. Unless authorized to speak on behalf of Relias, you must state a disclaimer that ' My statements and opinions on this site are my own and do not necessarily reflect the views of Relias, its officers, directors, or employees.' But remember, simply including this disclaimer does not relax or eliminate your obligation to comply with this policy.
- f. Hourly employees should not speak on behalf of Relias when off the clock.
- g. Attribute to the original author of a post when recommunicating others' posts where appropriate and be aware of any potential copyright, trademark, or other intellectual property issues with reposting a third party's posts.

1. News media: Contact the Public Relations Team before responding to any news media inquiries or posts about Relias.

1. Public Relations: If you spot a potential issue and believe an official company response is needed, immediately contact the Public Relations Team.
2. Social Media on behalf of Relias: Do not create Relias branded Social Media accounts without first requesting review and approval by the Social Team and Brand Team. This includes adding groups on existing pages. Please also include a business case. Relias owns all intellectual property and access to all Relias branded accounts. If you have access to a branded account, you must turn it over to the appropriate Social Team and Brand Team for administration.
3. Intellectual property laws : Employees must comply with all copyright, trademark, and intellectual property laws. Do not share Relias visual assets (including Relias fonts, Relias stock photography, Relias logos, Relias templates, or other branded materials or devices that are reserved solely for Relias) with third parties without prior Brand Team approval.
4. Personal use of Social Media: Employees should:

- a. Limit personal use of Social Media during working hours or on equipment provided by Relias unless such use is work-related as authorized by your manager or consistent with Relias policies. Such use must not involve any unprofessional or inappropriate conduct or content, must not interfere with your employment responsibilities or productivity, and must comply with this policy.
- b. Not use Relias email addresses to register on Social Media for personal use.

1. Social media accounts transfer upon departure:

- a. All company-related Social Media accounts and related postings maintained by employees remain the property of Relias.
- b. All information including the account, the login, and password should be returned to Relias at the end of the employee 's employment. No employee has the right to use the account after summary dismissal or termination, and only Relias is permitted to change the account names and settings.
- c. Where applicable law permits, Relias reserves the right to monitor, intercept and review, without further notice, employee activities using Relias IT resources and communications systems, including but not limited to Social Media postings and activities, for legitimate business purposes which include ascertaining and demonstrating that expected standards are being met by those using the IT resources and communication systems and for the detection and investigation of unauthorized use of IT resources and communication systems (including where necessary to prevent or detect crime).

1. Personal Social Media accounts: Relias respects its employees' personal online activity as a medium of self-expression. Employees must remember that they have responsibilities to the organization outside of working hours. Use separate accounts for personal and company-related use, and do not confuse the two unless a separate account is approved for company-related use by the Social Team and Brand Team. Be aware that data protection and other Relias policies still apply to your personal use of Social Media and that many platforms are public forums.
2. Emergency management: In an emergency or crisis, ensure that you communicate with the Social Team and Brand Team and any other team within Relias responsible for managing the situation, and follow their guidance. Please also see the Crisis Response Plan.
3. Policy Compliance:

- a. Social Media should never be used in a way that breaches any other Relias policies. If a post breaches any policies in another forum, it will also breach them in an online forum. For example, you are prohibited from using Social Media in a manner that breaches any of the policy requirements in other Relias policies including but not limited to those mentioned below in the Additional Policies section.
- b. Assigned workers and third parties who violate this policy are subject to being denied access to compa ny facilities, personnel and assets, and permission to perform services on Relias' behalf.
- c. Taking negative action against any employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy or cooperating in any investigation with respect to a potential policy violation is prohibited. Any employee who retaliates against any other employee for reporting a possible deviation from this policy or for cooperating in any investigation will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including summary dismissal or termination if warranted under the circumstances and permissible under applicable law.
- d. Breach of any policy requirements may result in disciplinary action up to and including summary dismissal or termination. Disciplinary action may be taken regardless of whether the breach is committed during working hours, and regardless of whether Relias equipment or facilities are used for the purpose of committing the breach. Any employee suspected of breaching this policy will be required to cooperate with any investigation.
- e. You may be required to remove any Social Media content that is considered to constitute a breach of this policy. Failure to comply may result in disciplinary action up to and including summary dismissal or termination if warranted under the circumstances and permissible under applicable law.
- f. Nothing in this policy will be interpreted or enforced in any manner to discourage or penalize communications between employees concerning working conditions or terms and conditions of employment (e.g., wages or benefits).
- g. This policy does not prohibit and will not be interpreted or enforced in a manner which could interfere with, restrain, or coerce employees from engaging in activities protected by federal or state labor rights (including any rights under the National Labor Relations Act and any whistleblower protections), including concerted activities, discussion of wages, benefits, and other items and conditions of employment.
- h. Any conduct, online or otherwise, that negatively or adversely impacts clients, customers, business partners, or Relias's legitimate business interests may result in disciplinary action, up to and including summary dismissal or termination.
- i. The Social Team and Brand Team have the overall responsibility for the effective operation of this policy. Questions regarding the content or application of this policy should be directed to the Social Team and Brand Team. Any misuse or questionable online posts/activity or questions about posting on a particular topic should be directed to the Public Relations Team.

1. Other Use: Relias encourages employees to socialize Relias content, news, events, and awards in accordance with this policy.
2. Additional Guidance: The guidelines in this policy are in addition to the ' Additional Policies and Documentation that Apply to Social Media Use' below and, together, they apply to any Social Media communications you make when speaking on behalf of Relias.

Special Exception to Acceptable Use Under This Policy - TikTok
